result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with cut-off content and a minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off, making it partially invisible on the screen
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel or grid layout to ensure all visible cards fit within the viewport without being truncated. Consider using proper overflow handling or adjusting card widths.

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section - the full name is not visible
issues.suggestion: Implement text overflow with ellipsis (...) or adjust the card layout to accommodate full restaurant names, or use text wrapping

issues.description: A category pill button is partially visible on the far right edge of the category filter row, suggesting incomplete rendering of the horizontal scroll area
issues.suggestion: Ensure the category scroll area is properly aligned or add visual indicators (like scroll hints) to show users there are more categories available
